svg.title: Order in dynamic systems under uncertainty
svg.desc: Timeline. Research: Fraunhofer, evaluating efficiency without ground truth; the flow efficiency research continues as a branch alongside the commercial work. From 2006: Processbench, performance pricing, German standard VDI 2817. 2012 to 2025: Hilti, the buyer's side of procurement on SAP Ariba. Now: SupplyConnect, swappable language models under control loops.
